verdicts.reason: A: the logo floats outside the card on the busy orange dunes, low-contrast and jammed against the left edge; the See Fares CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill that is hard to read; the card is cropped at the canvas top and bottom. B has the same tiny CTA and cropped card, and is worse because the Meridian logo collides with the card's left edge, the wordmark running into the white panel, while a dead empty strip sits to its left.
